records.trigger: Story adds new blocking dev-memory lifecycle gates (CHK-001/CHK-003); this is explicit behavior-change/gate work, so red evidence is required by the ProofStory high-assurance classifier.
records.observedFailure: Today none of the four DEV-entry guards (canStartDevGuard, canSkipPlanGuard, canReenterDevGuard) or the DONE guard (canFinishGuard) in packages/main/src/core/machine.ts reference dev-memory in any form -- grep -c 'devMemory|dev_memory|DevMemory' packages/main/src/core/machine.ts returns 0. A story can enter DEV via any of the three doors, or reach DONE, with zero recorded dev-memory preflight acknowledgement or finish-decision, which is exactly the gap this story closes.
records.note: Baseline captured pre-DEV on worktree HEAD. failingCommand today returns 0 (no dev-memory reference in any of the four guards); after CHK-001/CHK-003 land, the same command must return >0 (guard code references the new preflight-ack/finish-decision reader functions).
